claims.statement: URE reported 4,897 electricity-grid connection refusals totaling more than 107 GW in 2025.
PSE publishes planned connections, refusals, pending applications, and storage projects and updates the information at least quarterly.

contrary_evidence: The high refusal count shows that proximity to grid infrastructure is not sufficient evidence of connectability.
Experienced developers already maintain internal land and grid teams.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: source land through local agents and sell through grid consultants and developer databases.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: a portfolio of 25 assignable options and recurring lease interests could support a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in six to ten years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: automated screening and commissioned field agents keep founder work below 20 hours weekly.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: successful option assignments could exceed 65% gross margin, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: one assigned option repays a ten-site screening cohort.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: earn 80,000 PLN per assigned option or a 2% development-success fee.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: developers repeatedly buy sites while landowners refer adjacent parcels.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A proprietary refusal, substation, parcel, and landowner map improves site selection and creates an option inventory
fingerprint.customer: Battery-storage and renewable project developers seeking Polish sites
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Grid-consultant introductions and direct developer data-room access
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Exclusive conditional site rights bundled with standardized grid and planning diligence
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The developer pays when an option is reserved, assigned, or reaches a defined milestone
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A developer needs scarce land with credible grid proximity and clean option rights

founder_fit: The family renewable network and local Wielkopolska roots create a credible sourcing wedge.
This candidate uses nearly all available capital and therefore requires staged options only.
risks: Options can expire worthless and consume most available capital.
Planning, title, environmental, and grid defects can invalidate a site.

structure.commercial_archetype: Real-asset option aggregator and development-rights bank
structure.control_point: Exclusive conditional land option paired with documented grid and planning diligence
structure.critical_dependency: Landowner signatures and credible evidence of connection feasibility

thesis: Secure conditional land options near viable substations and sell de-risked site rights to storage and renewable developers.
title: Grid-Ready Site Option Bank
uncertainties: No landowner or developer demand commitment has been obtained.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
